A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immunogenicity of the anti-lymphocyte globulin is increased by absorption with antigen.
the immunosuppression induced by ALG is not mediated through the depletion of lymphoid tissue.
ALG preabsorption with immunizing antigen results in a loss of its immunosuppressive activity and a concomitant sensitization of the host to the antigen.
